description.value: The Waffle Bar is a made-to-order waffle counter nestled within Krause Berry Farms & Estate Winery, a family-owned Fraser Valley farm that has been operating since 1974 across more than 200 acres. Toppings rotate with the seasons — summer brings fresh strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries harvested directly from the surrounding fields, while winter and spring feature warm fruit compotes. It is a distinctive, farm-direct food stop in the agricultural flatlands east of Langley, with takeout served in fully biodegradable packaging.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, publicly accessible waffle counter operating within Krause Berry Farms & Estate Winery at 6179 248th Street, Langley, BC. Takeout is explicitly stated ('Take-out is always available, with 100% biodegradable packaging'), and vegan gluten-friendly waffles are a confirmed menu option. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM records this as a standalone node named 'Waffle Bar', but it is a service counter within Krause Berry Farms & Estate Winery — directory editors may want to clarify the relationship or ensure the parent farm is not also listed as a duplicate.
No phone number found in OSM or on the website content.
Address was absent from OSM; populated from website hours page ('6179 248th Street, Langley, BC') — should be verified against a map.

OSM opening_hours tag differs from website content (website describes spring hours as 7 days/week 9:30–3:30 for the Waffle Bar; OSM has a more restrictive seasonal schedule) — website is preferred per schema rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating food counter at a well-established Fraser Valley farm, publicly accessible and clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through the Langley agricultural area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Waffle Bar is served in the 'KB Corral' area of the main Krause Berry Farms property. Waffles are first-come, first-served with no reservations. A separate Krause Farm Store & Café exists at 23823 72nd Avenue, Langley — a distinct location.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Vegan Gluten-Friendly Waffle confirmed on menu (made with soy, rice flour, potato starch, tapioca starch, coconut milk, topped with vegan coco whip). Note: website explicitly states this is not a certified gluten-free facility and cross-contamination is possible
